propositions: transport.py has repeatedly hit the 800-LOC file-size cap, forcing reactive splitting that did not create stable homes for new code, perpetuating the cycle of growth and rescue extractions

The module's natural boundaries already exist as capability Protocols defined in _backend.py (TicketTransport, SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsAbsenceProbe) but are not being used to organize the code

Splitting transport.py into capability-aligned mixins (_base, _issues, _hierarchy, _links, _people) composed into JiraDataCenterTransport preserves single-class semantics, Protocol conformance, and caller contract while placing all files in the 100-500 LOC target band

The relocation is mechanical (behavior unchanged, no test assertions edited, _resolve_epic_link_field_id deduplicated) so that future capability-specific operations have a determined home based on capability instead of defaulting to the god file
